locations.note: Opening mission: a fashion show in a Paris palace where 47 hunts two spymasters selling state secrets.
In Sapienza, an invented town modelled on the Amalfi coast and Vernazza, 47 kills the scientists Silvio Caruso and Francesca De Santis and destroys their virus prototype in Caruso's lab.
A brewing military coup around a besieged Swedish consulate sends 47 into the souks of Marrakesh.
47 checks into a riverside Bangkok luxury hotel where a rock star is recording an album.
A militia training camp on a remote Colorado farm, where 47 must eliminate four targets at once.
The season finale is set at a secluded mountain hospital and spa in snowy Hokkaido.

routes.name: Agent 47
routes.note: From a Paris fashion show 47 follows the Shadow Client's trail through Sapienza on the Italian coast, Marrakesh, Bangkok and a Colorado militia farm to a mountain hospital in Hokkaido.
